reason: All runtime-valid arms proved real reduced prefill/decode execution on four TP workers and completed three performance and three LongBench-v2 repetitions. Dk104/18.75% was -2.746264% throughput and -25.459318 pp LongBench. Dk88/31.25% was -1.943667% throughput and -30.971129 pp LongBench. Dk64/50% was +8.301873% throughput but -9.448819 pp LongBench. No arm passes both performance and quality; GSM8K and native profiling were not started under their preregistered gate.
stopping_rules: Reject an arm if the plugin is not proven installed, registered and actually hit on every TP worker.
Reject or repair an arm if any real prefill/decode smoke fails or metadata/state shapes are not preserved.
Do not call a small mean difference a stable speedup when three-run intervals overlap or the change is within baseline noise.
Run repeated quality only for a runtime-valid arm with meaningful performance evidence; do not call a quality pass lossless proof.
Do not compare the paper's H100 training sequence-mixer number as if it were this Ascend full-model serving denominator.
next_gate: None for this closed identity. Final evidence audit passed with errors=[] and both Markdown and HTML reports are present. Any anomaly investigation requires a new experiment identity and fresh same-denominator baseline.
